title: The sextet with Charles Lloyd and Zawinul at its best
summary: At a Columbus concert Sam recalls the powerful sextet rhythm section of Zawinul, himself and Louis Hayes.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: And so we was playing, and it was in Columbus, I just couldn't stand it no more man, it was, a sextet, Charles Lloyd...
...was in the band then. 'Cause Yusef {Lateef} had left. But we had a helluva band man, this band was like,
man, this was one of the badd st sextets you ever wanna hear. Cause we had some helluva music in there, man. We used to, we used, I've seen people jump up from the table, man, you know.
Stuff be hot in there, boy.
It's rough in there, man, I've seen in the rhythm section boy we used to make people, man, just jump up from the table, Joe Zawinul, myself, and Louis Hayes.
It was some helluva moments, man, and that other stuff, I figured didn't have nothing to do with it, man.
